import sys,json,hashlib,datetime,os
from collections import Counter
path,start_s,end_s,cut_s,n_s,inode_s=sys.argv[1:]
start,end,cut=[datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(x) for x in (start_s,end_s,cut_s)]

with open(path,"rb") as f:
 if os.fstat(f.fileno()).st_ino!=int(inode_s):raise RuntimeError("log inode changed")
 while left:
  raw=f.readline(left)
  if not raw:raise RuntimeError("snapshot prefix shortened")
  left-=len(raw);h.update(raw)
  try:
   row=json.loads(raw)
   if not isinstance(row,dict):raise ValueError("nonobject")
   ts=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(row.get("ts","")).replace("Z","+00:00"))
   if ts.tzinfo is None:raise ValueError("naive timestamp")
  except (ValueError,TypeError):malformed+=1;continue
  latest=ts if latest is None or ts>latest else latest
  if not start<=ts<end:continue
  first=ts if first is None or ts<first else first;last=ts if last is None or ts>last else last
  status=row.get("status");status=status if status in ("scoring-off","scored","deadline-keep","late-ignored","daily-cap","cap3-pruned","cap3-shadowed","memo","paused") else "other"
  allcounts[status]+=1
  try:
   born=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(row.get("instanceStartedAt","")).replace("Z","+00:00"))
   if born.tzinfo is None:raise ValueError("naive birth")
  except (ValueError,TypeError):unbound+=1;continue
  if born>ts:future+=1
  if born<=cut:old+=1;continue
  counts[status]+=1;instances.add(str(row.get("instance")))
  v=row.get("loadedCommit");v=v if isinstance(v,str) and len(v) in (40,64) and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in v) else "unknown"
  versions[v]+=1
post=os.stat(path)
print(json.dumps({"window":{"start":start_s,"end":end_s,"bounds":"[start,end)","seconds":int((end-start).total_seconds())},"guard_cutoff":cut_s,"input":{"path":path,"inode":int(inode_s),"prefix_bytes":int(n_s),"prefix_sha256":h.hexdigest(),"inode_still_matches":post.st_ino==int(inode_s),"prefix_still_present":post.st_size>=int(n_s)},"all_window_status":dict(allcounts),"post_guard_status":dict(counts),"post_guard_instances":len(instances),"loaded_commit_labels":dict(versions),"malformed_prefix_rows":malformed,"unbound_window_rows":unbound,"future_birth_rows":future,"pre_guard_window_rows":old,"first_window_row":first.isoformat() if first else None,"last_window_row":last.isoformat() if last else None,"latest_prefix_row":latest.isoformat() if latest else None}))
